question: ______ won the (FIBA) Women's Basketball World Cup 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States of America.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **19th edition **of the** FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup** was held in **Sydney, Australia** from **September 22 to October 1st, 2022. **
 
• The tournament** featured twelve nations **competing for the championship title.
 
• **The United States women’s national basketball team **won the championship title after** defeating Australia **in the final match with a** score of 74-68.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The FIBA Basketball World Cup is the oldest international basketball tournament, first held in **1950 in Argentina.**
 
• The tournament takes place** every four years**, similar to other major international sporting events like the FIFA World Cup.
 
• It features **national teams from around the world**, with **32 teams** competing in recent editions.
 
• **The United States** has been the most successful nation in the tournament's history, winning the championship multiple times.
 
• The FIBA Basketball World Cup attracts significant attention and viewership worldwide, serving as a platform for cultural exchange and showcasing the talent and competitiveness of basketball on a global stage.
